effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] ＜De-Digivolve 2＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, add this card to the hand.
[Main] You may link this card to 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost. Then, until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.) and +3000 DP.
